description.en: 60-day SEP after job loss in Kentucky. Compare kynect Marketplace plans with subsidies, Kentucky Medicaid, and COBRA. Most Kentuckians pay under $100/mo.

h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in Kentucky? Here Are Your Health Insurance Options for 2026
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Kentucky? Estas Son Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico para 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of employer coverage to enroll in a new plan through kynect, Kentucky's state Marketplace. Kentucky Medicaid is free year-round if your income qualifies.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador para inscribirse en kynect, el Mercado estatal de Kentucky. Medicaid de Kentucky es gratis todo el ano si su ingreso califica.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura

body.en: Your 60-day loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your employer coverage ends. For example, if your last day of coverage is June 30, 2026, your SEP window runs July 1 through August 29, 2026. Miss that window and you typically wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period starting November 1, 2026, for 2027 kynect coverage. Kentucky Medicaid has no deadline and accepts applications year-round if your income qualifies.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura del empleador. Si su ultimo dia de cobertura es el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana va del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, tipicamente espera hasta la Inscripcion Abierta que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura 2027. Medicaid de Kentucky no tiene fecha limite.

label.es: Medicaid de Kentucky (si el ingreso califica)

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based health insurance in Kentucky triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Your three main paths are: (1) kynect Marketplace plan with income-based premium tax credits, typically $10 to $300 per month after subsidies in 2026; (2) Kentucky Medicaid (free year-round if your projected income falls under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, about $22,025 for a single person in 2026); and (3) COBRA continuation at 102% of the full premium, often $500 to $2,000 per month. Most Kentuckians who lose a job see their income drop enough to qualify for large Marketplace subsidies or Medicaid directly. Enroll through kynect.ky.gov or call a kynector (free certified enrollment helper available in all 120 Kentucky counties).
quickAnswer.es: Perder el seguro medico del trabajo en Kentucky activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias. Sus tres caminos principales son: (1) plan del Mercado kynect con creditos fiscales de prima basados en ingresos, tipicamente $10 a $300 al mes despues de subsidios en 2026; (2) Medicaid de Kentucky (gratis todo el ano si su ingreso proyectado cae bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, alrededor de $22,025 para una persona en 2026); y (3) continuacion COBRA al 102% de la prima completa, a menudo $500 a $2,000 al mes. La mayoria de kentuckianos que pierden trabajo califica para grandes subsidios del Mercado o directamente para Medicaid.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in Kentucky is stressful enough without also facing a health coverage gap. Federal HIPAA Section 9831 rules classify any involuntary loss of minimum essential coverage from an employer-sponsored plan as a qualifying life event (QLE), which opens a 60-day Marketplace Special Enrollment Period. Kentucky runs its own state-based Marketplace called kynect (kynect.ky.gov), separate from the federal HealthCare.gov, with three carriers available for 2026: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (covering 108 of 120 counties), and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare in the Bluegrass region. The 2026 kynect Open Enrollment Period ended January 15, 2026. Without a SEP triggered by your job loss, you have no path to subsidized kynect coverage until the 2027 Open Enrollment Period opens November 1, 2026. Acting within 60 days is critical. Kentucky also expanded Medicaid under the ACA in January 2014 and has maintained full expansion continuously. For 2026, Kentucky Medicaid covers adults aged 19 to 64 at up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level (about $22,025 for one person), with no coverage gap. If your projected income after job loss falls below that threshold, applying through kynect or the Benefind portal (benefind.ky.gov) for Medicaid may be your fastest and most affordable path.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Kentucky es suficientemente estresante sin enfrentar ademas una brecha de cobertura medica. Las reglas federales de la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA clasifican cualquier perdida involuntaria de cobertura esencial minima de un plan patrocinado por el empleador como un evento calificador de vida (QLE), que abre un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias en el Mercado. Kentucky opera su propio Mercado estatal llamado kynect (kynect.ky.gov), separado del HealthCare.gov federal, con tres portadores disponibles para 2026: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (cubriendo 108 de 120 condados), y Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare en la region Bluegrass. El Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta de kynect 2026 termino el 15 de enero de 2026. Sin un SEP activado por la perdida de trabajo, no tiene acceso a cobertura subsidiada de kynect hasta que la Inscripcion Abierta 2027 abra el 1 de noviembre de 2026. Kentucky tambien expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA en enero de 2014 y ha mantenido la expansion completa continuamente. Para 2026, Medicaid de Kentucky cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (alrededor de $22,025 para una persona), sin brecha de cobertura.

introParagraphs.en: Kentucky's Medicaid program, administered through managed care organizations, covers approximately 1.4 million Kentuckians as of 2026. Under HB 2 enacted in April 2026, expansion adults now pay small copays ($5 for most services, $1 for prescription drugs, capped at 5% of family income), and community engagement requirements of 80 hours per month are expected to begin tracking in December 2026 with enforcement starting January 2027. Exemptions include pregnant individuals, medically frail individuals, caregivers of dependents, full-time students, and those with serious mental illness or substance use disorder. Even with these changes, Kentucky Medicaid remains far cheaper than any COBRA or kynect premium for low-income individuals. COBRA in Kentucky averages roughly $702 per month for an individual, while a kynect Silver plan after premium tax credits typically costs $10 to $150 per month for someone earning $25,000 to $40,000 per year. For children, Kentucky CHIP (administered under Medicaid) covers kids at incomes up to 218% FPL with low or no premiums, year-round. Understanding which program fits your income and household size is the first decision you need to make within that 60-day window.
introParagraphs.es: El programa Medicaid de Kentucky, administrado a traves de organizaciones de atencion administrada, cubre aproximadamente 1.4 millones de kentuckianos en 2026. Bajo el HB 2 aprobado en abril de 2026, los adultos de la expansion ahora pagan copagos pequenos ($5 para la mayoria de servicios, $1 para medicamentos recetados, con limite del 5% del ingreso familiar), y los requisitos de participacion comunitaria de 80 horas al mes se espera que comiencen a rastrearse en diciembre de 2026 con aplicacion a partir de enero de 2027. Incluso con estos cambios, Medicaid de Kentucky sigue siendo mucho mas barato que cualquier prima de COBRA o kynect para personas de bajos ingresos. COBRA en Kentucky promedia aproximadamente $702 al mes para un individuo, mientras que un plan Silver de kynect despues de creditos fiscales tipicamente cuesta $10 a $150 al mes para alguien que gana $25,000 a $40,000 al ano. Para ninos, el CHIP de Kentucky cubre a los ninos con ingresos de hasta el 218% del FPL con primas bajas o nulas, todo el ano.

name.en: Determine your last day of employer coverage
name.es: Determine su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador

text.en: Check your termination letter or contact your HR department to confirm the exact date your employer health plan ends. Most plans end on the last day of the month in which employment ends, but some end on the final day of work. Your 60-day SEP clock starts the day after coverage ends, so this date is critical for calculating your application deadline.
text.es: Revise su carta de terminacion o contacte a su departamento de Recursos Humanos para confirmar la fecha exacta en que termina su plan de salud del empleador. La mayoria de planes terminan el ultimo dia del mes en que termina el empleo, pero algunos terminan el ultimo dia de trabajo. Su contador de 60 dias del SEP comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura.

name.en: Calculate your projected new household income
name.es: Calcule su nuevo ingreso del hogar proyectado

text.en: Use only what you expect to earn going forward, not your old salary. Include unemployment compensation (it counts as income for ACA subsidy calculations under Modified Adjusted Gross Income, or MAGI). If your projected annual income falls below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level (about $22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026), check Kentucky Medicaid first through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov before shopping kynect Marketplace plans.
text.es: Use solo lo que espera ganar en adelante, no su salario anterior. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo (cuenta como ingreso para calculos de subsidios del ACA bajo el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado, o MAGI). Si su ingreso anual proyectado cae por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (alrededor de $22,025 para una persona, $45,540 para una familia de 4 en 2026), verifique Medicaid de Kentucky primero.

name.en: Apply for Kentucky Medicaid if income qualifies
name.es: Solicite Medicaid de Kentucky si el ingreso califica

text.en: Log in to kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov and submit a Medicaid application. Kentucky is an expansion state with no coverage gap for adults aged 19 to 64 under 138% FPL. Medicaid is free or near-free, covers comprehensive benefits, and has no enrollment deadline. Under HB 2 enacted April 2026, small copays ($5 per service, $1 per prescription) apply for expansion adults, capped at 5% of family income. Community engagement tracking begins December 2026 with exemptions for caregivers, pregnant individuals, and medically frail individuals.
text.es: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov y envie una solicitud de Medicaid. Kentucky es un estado con expansion sin brecha de cobertura para adultos de 19 a 64 anos bajo el 138% FPL. Medicaid es gratuito o casi gratuito, cubre beneficios integrales y no tiene fecha limite de inscripcion. Bajo el HB 2 de abril de 2026, se aplican copagos pequenos ($5 por servicio, $1 por receta) para adultos de la expansion.

name.en: Compare kynect Marketplace plans during your 60-day SEP
name.es: Compare planes del Mercado kynect durante su SEP de 60 dias

text.en: Log in to kynect.ky.gov and enter your ZIP code and projected income to see available plans with premium tax credit amounts applied. Kentucky's kynect has three carriers in 2026: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare, and Passport Health Plan (Bluegrass region only). Compare Silver plans for cost-sharing reductions if your income is 100 to 250% FPL. Check that your current doctors are in the plan network before selecting. Silver plans with CSR typically offer the best overall value for moderate incomes. You can also call a free kynector enrollment assistant using the kynect help line at 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328).
text.es: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov e ingrese su codigo postal e ingreso proyectado para ver los planes disponibles con los montos de credito fiscal de prima aplicados. kynect de Kentucky tiene tres portadores en 2026: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare, y Passport Health Plan (solo region Bluegrass). Compare planes Silver para reducciones de costos compartidos si su ingreso es del 100 al 250% FPL. Verifique que sus medicos actuales esten en la red del plan antes de seleccionar.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA as a backup only

text.en: Federal COBRA applies if your former employer had 20 or more employees. COBRA charges 102% of the full premium (employer plus your share plus 2% admin fee), averaging about $702 per month for individuals in Kentucky in 2026. Kentucky also has a state continuation law (Mini-COBRA) for employers with fewer than 20 employees, covering up to 18 months at 102% of the full premium for fully-insured plans. COBRA is worth considering only if you have active treatment with a provider not in any kynect network, or if you have already met a large deductible for the year. Otherwise, kynect with premium tax credits is almost always cheaper.
text.es: El COBRA federal aplica si su empleador anterior tenia 20 o mas empleados. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa (parte del empleador mas la suya mas la tarifa administrativa del 2%), con un promedio de aproximadamente $702 al mes para individuos en Kentucky en 2026. Kentucky tambien tiene una ley de continuacion estatal (Mini-COBRA) para empleadores con menos de 20 empleados, cubriendo hasta 18 meses al 102% de la prima completa. COBRA solo vale la pena si tiene tratamiento activo con un proveedor que no esta en ninguna red de kynect, o si ya alcanzo un deducible grande para el ano.

name.en: Check if a spouse's employer plan is available
name.es: Verifique si el plan del empleador de un conyuge esta disponible

text.en: Losing job-based coverage is also a qualifying life event for your spouse's employer plan. Your spouse's employer typically gives you 30 days from your coverage loss date to enroll as a dependent. Submit the required documentation (your termination letter plus proof of prior coverage) to your spouse's HR department. A spouse's employer plan often costs less than both COBRA and kynect, especially when the employer subsidizes the dependent premium.
text.es: Perder la cobertura del trabajo tambien es un evento calificador para el plan del empleador de su conyuge. El empleador de su conyuge tipicamente le da 30 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura para inscribirse como dependiente. Presente la documentacion requerida (carta de terminacion mas prueba de cobertura previa) al departamento de Recursos Humanos de su conyuge. Un plan del empleador del conyuge a menudo cuesta menos que tanto COBRA como kynect.

name.en: Enroll and gather your 1095-A for tax filing
name.es: Inscribase y reuna su 1095-A para declarar impuestos

text.en: Complete enrollment through kynect.ky.gov before your 60-day SEP deadline. Once enrolled in a kynect Marketplace plan, you will receive a Form 1095-A by January 31, 2027, which you must submit with your federal tax return using Form 8962 to reconcile your premium tax credits. Keep all documentation of your qualifying life event (termination letter, HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage, or COBRA election notice) for at least three years.
text.es: Complete la inscripcion a traves de kynect.ky.gov antes de su fecha limite del SEP de 60 dias. Una vez inscrito en un plan del Mercado kynect, recibira un Formulario 1095-A antes del 31 de enero de 2027, que debe presentar con su declaracion de impuestos federal usando el Formulario 8962 para reconciliar sus creditos fiscales de prima. Guarde toda la documentacion de su evento calificador de vida por al menos tres anos.

The ACA subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced PTCs expired January 1, 2026: income above 400% FPL ($63,840 single, $132,000 family of 4) receives no premium tax credit. Medicaid is free for most enrollees. COBRA premium averages from KHBE 2026 data.
footnote.es: Los costos del Mercado kynect dependen del ingreso proyectado 2026 y el tamano del hogar. El acantilado de subsidios del ACA regreso para 2026 despues de que los PTCs mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026: los ingresos por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 individual, $132,000 familia de 4) no reciben credito fiscal de prima. Medicaid es gratis para la mayoria.

intro.en: The most expensive mistakes Kentuckians make after losing job-based coverage:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los kentuckianos cometen despues de perder cobertura del trabajo:

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing kynect plans. COBRA in Kentucky averages $702 per month for individuals before any subsidies. A kynect Silver plan with premium tax credits often costs $10 to $150 per month for the same person.
items.es: Aceptar COBRA sin comparar planes kynect. COBRA en Kentucky promedia $702 al mes para individuos. Un plan Silver de kynect con creditos fiscales a menudo cuesta $10 a $150 al mes para la misma persona.

items.en: Reporting your old salary instead of projected income. kynect calculates subsidy eligibility based on projected annual income for the rest of the year, not what you earned while employed. A lower projected income produces a larger premium tax credit.
items.es: Reportar su salario antiguo en lugar del ingreso proyectado. kynect calcula la elegibilidad del subsidio basada en el ingreso anual proyectado para el resto del ano, no lo que gano mientras estaba empleado.

items.en: Forgetting to count unemployment compensation. Kentucky unemployment benefits count as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for ACA subsidy and Medicaid eligibility calculations. Include this in your income estimate on kynect.
items.es: Olvidar contar los beneficios de desempleo. Los beneficios de desempleo de Kentucky cuentan como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para calculos de elegibilidad del ACA y Medicaid. Incluya esto en su estimacion de ingresos en kynect.

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window. Without the SEP triggered by your job loss, you cannot enroll in a kynect plan until November 1, 2026, for coverage starting January 1, 2027, leaving you uninsured for months.
items.es: Perder la ventana del SEP de 60 dias. Sin el SEP activado por la perdida de trabajo, no puede inscribirse en un plan kynect hasta el 1 de noviembre de 2026, dejandolo sin seguro por meses.

items.en: Not checking Kentucky Medicaid first. If your projected income qualifies, Kentucky Medicaid is faster to enroll in through kynect, is free or nearly free, and does not have a 60-day deadline.
items.es: No verificar Medicaid de Kentucky primero. Si su ingreso proyectado califica, Medicaid de Kentucky es mas rapido de inscribir a traves de kynect, es gratuito o casi gratuito, y no tiene fecha limite de 60 dias.

items.en: Choosing a kynect plan without checking the provider network. Kentucky's three 2026 carriers use different networks. Your current doctors, specialists, and hospital may not be in all plans, especially in rural eastern Kentucky counties with limited carrier options.
items.es: Elegir un plan kynect sin verificar la red de proveedores. Los tres portadores de kynect 2026 usan redes diferentes. Sus medicos actuales, especialistas y hospital pueden no estar en todos los planes, especialmente en los condados rurales del este de Kentucky.

stateRules.rule: Kentucky operates kynect as its own state-based Marketplace (KHBE), separate from HealthCare.gov. Kentuckians must enroll at kynect.ky.gov, not healthcare.gov. Three carriers in 2026: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (108 of 120 counties), Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (Bluegrass region). Medicaid is administered through the Cabinet for Health and Family Services (CHFS) via four managed care organizations.

Kentucky Mini-COBRA (KRS Chapter 304.18): Employees of employers with fewer than 20 employees on a fully-insured group health plan can continue coverage for up to 18 months at 102% of the full premium. Must have been covered for at least 3 continuous months before qualifying event. The 60-day election window applies.

Kentucky HB 2 (enacted April 2026): Medicaid expansion adults (ages 19 to 64, income under 138% FPL) now have small copays: $5 for most healthcare services, $1 for prescription drugs, capped at 5% of family income. Community engagement (80 hours/month) begins tracking December 2026; enforcement starts January 2027. Exemptions apply for pregnant individuals, medically frail, caregivers, full-time students, and those with serious mental illness or substance use disorder.

Kentucky CHIP covers children under age 19 in families with income up to 218% FPL through the Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program, administered within the state Medicaid managed care framework. Enrollment is year-round through kynect or benefind.ky.gov.

en: Missing the 60-day SEP window: submitting a kynect application more than 60 days after the employer coverage loss date disqualifies you from the SEP. Applications after Day 60 are denied without another qualifying life event.

Insufficient documentation of the qualifying event: kynect requires proof that your employer coverage ended (termination letter, HIPAA certificate, or COBRA notice). Applications without documentation are flagged for verification and may be delayed.

Reporting prior-year salary instead of projected income: kynect calculates premium tax credits based on projected 2026 income. Reporting your old salary overstates income, reduces your subsidy, and may cause a reconciliation penalty on your 2026 1095-A when you file taxes.

Applying without checking Kentucky Medicaid first: applicants near the 138% FPL line who enroll in a kynect plan may later discover they qualified for free Medicaid. kynect should automatically screen for Medicaid, but verifying your income estimate before final plan selection avoids this.

Selecting a plan without confirming provider network: Kentucky's three 2026 kynect carriers use different networks. Choosing a plan that does not include your primary care physician, specialist, or preferred hospital results in out-of-network costs or care disruption.
es: Perder la ventana del SEP de 60 dias: presentar una solicitud de kynect mas de 60 dias despues de la fecha de perdida de cobertura del empleador lo descalifica del SEP.

Documentacion insuficiente del evento calificador: kynect requiere prueba de que su cobertura del empleador termino (carta de terminacion, certificado HIPAA, o aviso COBRA). Las solicitudes sin documentacion se marcan para verificacion.

Reportar el salario del ano anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado: kynect calcula los creditos fiscales de prima basados en el ingreso proyectado de 2026. Reportar su salario anterior sobreestima el ingreso y reduce su subsidio.
Solicitar sin verificar Medicaid de Kentucky primero: los solicitantes cerca del 138% FPL que se inscriben en un plan kynect pueden descubrir que calificaban para Medicaid gratis.

Seleccionar un plan sin confirmar la red de proveedores: los tres portadores de kynect 2026 usan redes diferentes. Elegir un plan que no incluye a su medico de atencion primaria resulta en costos fuera de la red.

heading.en: COBRA vs kynect Marketplace vs Spouse's Plan: Which Should You Choose?
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado kynect vs Plan del Conyuge: Cual Debe Elegir?

body.en: After losing job-based coverage in Kentucky in 2026, four pathways open immediately. Kentucky Medicaid comes first: apply through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov if your projected annual income falls below 138% FPL ($22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of four). Kentucky is a full expansion state with no coverage gap for adults aged 19 to 64, and Medicaid enrollment has no 60-day deadline. kynect Marketplace plans (the ACA exchange) come second for most people whose income exceeds the Medicaid threshold. kynect uses premium tax credits to bring Silver plan costs to $10 to $300 per month for most enrollees earning 139% to 400% FPL, per KFF 2026 benchmark data. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026, after enhanced PTCs expired, so income above $63,840 for a single person receives no premium tax credit. A spouse's employer plan is the third path: if your spouse works for a company that offers health coverage, your job loss is a qualifying life event for that plan too, giving you 30 days to enroll as a dependent. This is often the cheapest path when the employer subsidizes the dependent premium. Federal COBRA is the last resort: it preserves your old plan at 102% of the full premium (employer plus your share plus 2% admin fee), averaging roughly $702 per month for individuals in Kentucky. COBRA makes sense only if you have active treatment with a provider who is not in any kynect network, or if you have already met a large calendar-year deductible that would be forfeited under a new plan. Kentucky Mini-COBRA (KRS Chapter 304.18) mirrors this logic for small employers with fewer than 20 employees. The decision rule: Medicaid first (free, year-round), spouse plan if available and cheaper, kynect with subsidies for most, COBRA as a last resort.
body.es: Despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Kentucky en 2026, cuatro caminos se abren de inmediato. Medicaid de Kentucky es el primero: solicite a traves de kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov si su ingreso anual proyectado cae por debajo del 138% FPL ($22,025 para una persona, $45,540 para una familia de cuatro). Kentucky es un estado de expansion completa sin brecha de cobertura para adultos de 19 a 64 anos, y la inscripcion en Medicaid no tiene fecha limite de 60 dias. Los planes del Mercado kynect vienen en segundo lugar para la mayoria de personas cuyo ingreso supera el umbral de Medicaid. kynect usa creditos fiscales de prima para llevar los costos del plan Silver a $10 a $300 al mes para la mayoria de inscritos que ganan del 139% al 400% FPL. El plan del conyuge es el tercer camino: si su conyuge trabaja para una empresa que ofrece cobertura de salud, la perdida de su trabajo tambien es un evento calificador para ese plan. COBRA federal es el ultimo recurso, promediando aproximadamente $702 al mes para individuos en Kentucky. La regla de decision: Medicaid primero (gratis, todo el ano), plan del conyuge si esta disponible y es mas barato, kynect con subsidios para la mayoria, COBRA como ultimo recurso.

heading.en: Kentucky Medicaid Eligibility After Job Loss in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad de Medicaid de Kentucky Despues de Perder el Trabajo en 2026

paragraphs.en: Losing job-based coverage in Kentucky often triggers Medicaid eligibility you did not have while employed. Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA in January 2014 and covers adults aged 19 to 64 with income under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, which is $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of four in 2026. Kentucky's program is managed through four Medicaid Managed Care Organizations (MCOs): Aetna Better Health of Kentucky, Humana Healthy Horizons in Kentucky, Molina Healthcare of Kentucky, and WellCare of Kentucky. All four cover the same core Medicaid benefits, but network composition varies. Apply through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov; kynect will automatically screen your household for both Medicaid and Marketplace eligibility in one application. For most Kentuckians, Medicaid eligibility is determined within days of a complete application.
paragraphs.es: Perder la cobertura del trabajo en Kentucky a menudo activa la elegibilidad de Medicaid que no tenia mientras estaba empleado. Kentucky expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA en enero de 2014 y cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, que es $22,025 para una persona y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro en 2026. El programa de Kentucky se administra a traves de cuatro Organizaciones de Atencion Administrada de Medicaid: Aetna Better Health of Kentucky, Humana Healthy Horizons in Kentucky, Molina Healthcare of Kentucky, y WellCare of Kentucky. Solicite a traves de kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov; kynect verificara automaticamente su hogar para elegibilidad tanto de Medicaid como del Mercado en una sola solicitud.

paragraphs.en: Kentucky HB 2, enacted in April 2026, introduced two significant changes for Medicaid expansion adults: small copays ($5 for most healthcare services, $1 for prescription drugs, capped at 5% of family income per month) and community engagement requirements of 80 hours per month of work, education, job training, or community service. Tracking for community engagement begins December 2026 with enforcement starting January 2027. Critical exemptions apply: pregnant individuals, medically frail individuals, caregivers of dependents, full-time students, and those with serious mental illness or substance use disorder are all exempt from the work requirement. Even with these copays, Kentucky Medicaid remains far less expensive than any kynect plan or COBRA premium for qualifying individuals. The 10 non-expansion states (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, Wyoming) are not an issue for Kentucky residents, as Kentucky has maintained full expansion continuously since 2014.
paragraphs.es: El HB 2 de Kentucky, promulgado en abril de 2026, introdujo dos cambios significativos para los adultos de la expansion de Medicaid: copagos pequenos ($5 para la mayoria de servicios de salud, $1 para medicamentos recetados, con un limite del 5% del ingreso familiar al mes) y requisitos de participacion comunitaria de 80 horas al mes. El seguimiento de la participacion comunitaria comienza en diciembre de 2026 con aplicacion a partir de enero de 2027. Se aplican exenciones criticas: personas embarazadas, personas medicamente fragiles, cuidadores de dependientes, estudiantes de tiempo completo y personas con enfermedad mental grave o trastorno por uso de sustancias estan exentas del requisito de trabajo. Incluso con estos copagos, Medicaid de Kentucky sigue siendo mucho menos costoso que cualquier plan kynect o prima de COBRA para individuos que califican.

heading.en: How kynect Works After Job Loss: Kentucky's State Marketplace
heading.es: Como Funciona kynect Despues de Perder el Trabajo: El Mercado Estatal de Kentucky

paragraphs.en: Kentucky operates kynect (kynect.ky.gov), its own state-based health insurance exchange through the Kentucky Health Benefit Exchange (KHBE), separate from the federal HealthCare.gov platform. This matters for Kentucky residents because all Marketplace enrollment, plan selection, and subsidy applications must go through kynect, not HealthCare.gov. For 2026, three carriers offer plans on kynect: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (Pathway HMO and Transition HMO networks, available statewide), Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (available in 108 of 120 counties), and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (available in select Bluegrass-region counties, including Fayette and surrounding areas). Carrier availability varies significantly by county, and rural eastern Kentucky counties may have only one carrier option. Enter your ZIP code in kynect's plan finder to see exactly which carriers and plans are available where you live.
paragraphs.es: Kentucky opera kynect (kynect.ky.gov), su propio intercambio de seguros de salud basado en el estado a traves del Intercambio de Beneficios de Salud de Kentucky (KHBE), separado de la plataforma federal HealthCare.gov. Para 2026, tres portadores ofrecen planes en kynect: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (redes Pathway HMO y Transition HMO, disponibles en todo el estado), Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (disponible en 108 de 120 condados), y Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (disponible en condados selectos de la region Bluegrass). La disponibilidad del portador varia significativamente por condado. Ingrese su codigo postal en el buscador de planes de kynect para ver exactamente que portadores y planes estan disponibles donde vive.

paragraphs.en: Free enrollment help is available in all 120 Kentucky counties through kynectors, state-certified enrollment assisters trained by KHBE. Kynectors are particularly active in rural eastern Kentucky counties where carrier choice is more limited and health literacy barriers are higher. Call kynect's help line at 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328) to be connected with a kynector near you. Licensed insurance brokers can also help you compare kynect plans at no cost to you, as broker commissions are paid by the carrier. When comparing kynect plans after job loss, prioritize Silver plans if your income is between 100% and 250% FPL: Silver plans with Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR) significantly lower your deductibles and copays and offer far better out-of-pocket value than Bronze plans for most ongoing medical needs. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 for an individual and $21,200 for a family across all metal tiers.
paragraphs.es: Ayuda gratuita para inscripcion esta disponible en los 120 condados de Kentucky a traves de kynectors, asistentes de inscripcion certificados por el estado y capacitados por KHBE. Llame a la linea de ayuda de kynect al 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328) para conectarse con un kynector cerca de usted. Al comparar planes kynect despues de perder el trabajo, priorice los planes Silver si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 250% FPL: los planes Silver con Reducciones de Costos Compartidos (CSR) reducen significativamente sus deducibles y copagos. El maximo de gastos de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 para un individuo y $21,200 para una familia.

heading.en: Documents You Will Need to Enroll Through kynect After Job Loss
heading.es: Documentos que Necesitara para Inscribirse en kynect Despues de Perder el Trabajo

paragraphs.en: Three categories of documents are required for a complete kynect SEP application. First, proof of the qualifying life event: a termination letter from your employer on company letterhead confirming your last day of employment and the date your employer health coverage ends, OR a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage (required under Section 9831 to document prior minimum essential coverage for SEP eligibility), OR a COBRA election notice if your employer issued one. Second, identity and residence documentation: a Kentucky driver's license, state-issued ID, or passport for each adult applicant; Social Security numbers for all household members; and proof of Kentucky residence such as a utility bill, lease agreement, or bank statement dated within 60 days. Third, income documentation: recent pay stubs (last 2 to 4 weeks while employed), your 2025 W-2 or tax return for reference, your Kentucky Career Center unemployment award letter showing weekly benefit amount if applicable, and any other income sources for the household. Having all three categories ready before you start your kynect application reduces delays and prevents requests for additional information that can push you close to the 60-day deadline.
paragraphs.es: Tres categorias de documentos son necesarias para una solicitud completa del SEP de kynect. Primero, prueba del evento calificador de vida: carta de terminacion de su empleador confirmando su ultimo dia de empleo y la fecha en que termina la cobertura de salud del empleador, O certificado de cobertura acreditable HIPAA, O aviso de eleccion COBRA. Segundo, documentacion de identidad y residencia: licencia de conducir de Kentucky, identificacion estatal, o pasaporte para cada solicitante adulto; numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar; y prueba de residencia en Kentucky. Tercero, documentacion de ingresos: talones de pago recientes, W-2 de 2025 o declaracion de impuestos, carta de beneficios de desempleo del Centro de Carrera de Kentucky si aplica. Tener estas tres categorias listas antes de comenzar su solicitud en kynect reduce demoras.

en.question: How long do I have to get health insurance after losing my job in Kentucky?
en.answer: Kentucky residents losing job-based health insurance have 60 days from the last day of employer coverage to enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan under the loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Your 60-day clock starts the day after your employer coverage ends, not the day you received your termination notice. For example, if your employer coverage ends June 30, 2026, your kynect SEP window runs July 1 through August 29, 2026. Separately, you also have 60 days to elect COBRA, and 30 days to enroll in a spouse's employer plan. Kentucky Medicaid has no deadline and accepts applications year-round through kynect.ky.gov.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it in Kentucky after job loss?
en.answer: COBRA in Kentucky averages roughly $702 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage in 2026, reflecting 102% of the full employer-plus-employee premium. For most Kentuckians who have lost income after job loss, a kynect Silver plan with premium tax credits costs $10 to $150 per month for the same person, making COBRA rarely the better choice. COBRA has two legitimate use cases: you have active ongoing treatment with a provider or specialist not covered by any kynect carrier network, or you have already met a large deductible for the 2026 calendar year that would reset under a new plan. In both cases, compare the cost of remaining on COBRA for the rest of the year against the kynect out-of-pocket maximum before deciding.

en.question: Do I qualify for Kentucky Medicaid after losing my job?
en.answer: Kentucky residents aged 19 to 64 qualify for Kentucky Medicaid if projected annual household income falls below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: $22,025 for a single person, $29,820 for a household of two, and $45,540 for a family of four in 2026. Kentucky is a full Medicaid expansion state with no coverage gap for non-parent adults. Apply through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov year-round. Under HB 2 enacted April 2026, expansion adults now pay small copays ($5 per service, $1 per prescription, capped at 5% of family income). Eligibility is based on projected income going forward, not your former salary. Unemployment compensation counts toward income.

en.question: How do I document my job loss for the kynect SEP application?
en.answer: kynect requires documentation that your employer health coverage has ended or will end. Acceptable documentation includes: (1) a termination or layoff letter from your employer on company letterhead stating your last day of employment and when health coverage ends; (2) a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage, which your employer is required to provide within a reasonable time under Section 9831 federal rules; (3) a COBRA election notice if your employer issued one, which confirms your coverage termination date. If your employer has not yet provided documentation, call HR and request it in writing. kynect allows you to submit documentation after initial application, but delays can push you toward your 60-day deadline.

en.question: What is kynect and how is it different from HealthCare.gov?
en.answer: kynect (kynect.ky.gov) is Kentucky's own state-based health insurance marketplace, operated by the Kentucky Health Benefit Exchange (KHBE). Kentucky residents must use kynect to enroll in subsidized ACA Marketplace plans, not the federal HealthCare.gov platform. kynect handles both Marketplace plan enrollment and Medicaid applications for Kentucky residents in a single portal. For 2026, kynect has three carriers: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (108 of 120 counties), and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (Bluegrass region). Free enrollment help from certified kynectors is available in all 120 Kentucky counties. Call 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328) to reach the kynect help line.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP window after losing my job in Kentucky?
en.answer: If you miss the 60-day loss-of-coverage SEP after losing your job in Kentucky, your options narrow significantly. Kentucky Medicaid remains open year-round if your income qualifies under 138% FPL. For kynect Marketplace plans, you typically cannot enroll until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through January 15 each year (so November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage). An exception applies if another qualifying life event occurs in the meantime, such as a marriage, birth of a child, or a move to a new county. Without a new qualifying event, you may face months without subsidized coverage. This is the primary reason acting within the 60-day window is critical.

en.question: Does unemployment income count for kynect ACA subsidy eligibility in Kentucky?
en.answer: Kentucky unemployment compensation counts as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for both kynect Marketplace subsidy eligibility and Kentucky Medicaid eligibility calculations. When applying on kynect, estimate your projected total household income for all of 2026, including any unemployment benefits you expect to receive. Using only your post-job-loss zero income may show you as Medicaid-eligible even if unemployment brings you above the 138% FPL line. An honest estimate that includes unemployment benefits prevents subsidy reconciliation penalties when you file your 2026 federal tax return using Form 8962 and your 1095-A.

en.question: What happens to my children's coverage after I lose my job in Kentucky?
en.answer: Kentucky CHIP covers children under age 19 in families with income up to 218% of the Federal Poverty Level ($42,000 for a family of three in 2026), with low or no premiums and year-round enrollment. Children in families with income below 200% FPL are generally enrolled in Medicaid directly. Kentucky CHIP enrollment is administered through the same kynect.ky.gov and benefind.ky.gov applications as Medicaid. Children may qualify even if the adults in the household do not qualify for Medicaid. Apply immediately after job loss, as Kentucky CHIP has no 60-day deadline, and coverage is comprehensive with very low out-of-pocket costs.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para obtener seguro medico despues de perder mi trabajo en Kentucky?
es.answer: Los residentes de Kentucky que pierden el seguro medico del trabajo tienen 60 dias desde el ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado kynect bajo el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) por perdida de cobertura. Su contador de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura del empleador. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura del empleador termina el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana del SEP de kynect va del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Adicionalmente, tiene 60 dias para elegir COBRA y 30 dias para inscribirse en el plan del empleador de su conyuge. Medicaid de Kentucky no tiene fecha limite y acepta solicitudes todo el ano a traves de kynect.ky.gov.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA en Kentucky despues de perder el trabajo?
es.answer: COBRA en Kentucky promedia aproximadamente $702 al mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar en 2026, reflejando el 102% de la prima completa del empleador mas el empleado. Para la mayoria de kentuckianos que han perdido ingresos despues de perder el trabajo, un plan Silver de kynect con creditos fiscales de prima cuesta $10 a $150 al mes para la misma persona, haciendo que COBRA raramente sea la mejor opcion. COBRA tiene dos casos de uso legitimos: tiene tratamiento activo con un proveedor no cubierto por ninguna red de portadores de kynect, o ya ha alcanzado un deducible grande para el ano calendario 2026 que se reiniciaria bajo un nuevo plan.

es.question: Califico para Medicaid de Kentucky despues de perder mi trabajo?
es.answer: Los residentes de Kentucky de 19 a 64 anos califican para Medicaid de Kentucky si el ingreso anual del hogar proyectado cae por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: $22,025 para una persona, $29,820 para un hogar de dos personas, y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro en 2026. Kentucky es un estado de expansion completa de Medicaid sin brecha de cobertura para adultos no padres. Solicite a traves de kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov todo el ano. Bajo el HB 2 aprobado en abril de 2026, los adultos de la expansion ahora pagan copagos pequenos ($5 por servicio, $1 por receta, con limite del 5% del ingreso familiar). La elegibilidad se basa en el ingreso proyectado futuro, no en su salario anterior.

es.question: Como documento la perdida de trabajo para la solicitud del SEP de kynect?
es.answer: kynect requiere documentacion de que su cobertura de salud del empleador ha terminado o terminara. La documentacion aceptable incluye: (1) carta de terminacion o despido de su empleador en papel membretado de la empresa indicando su ultimo dia de empleo y cuando termina la cobertura de salud; (2) certificado de cobertura acreditable HIPAA, que su empleador debe proporcionar bajo las reglas federales de la Seccion 9831; (3) aviso de eleccion COBRA si su empleador lo emitio. Si su empleador aun no ha proporcionado documentacion, llame a Recursos Humanos y solicite por escrito. kynect le permite enviar documentacion despues de la solicitud inicial, pero las demoras pueden acercarlo a su fecha limite de 60 dias.

es.question: Que es kynect y como es diferente de HealthCare.gov?
es.answer: kynect (kynect.ky.gov) es el mercado de seguros de salud propio de Kentucky, operado por el Intercambio de Beneficios de Salud de Kentucky (KHBE). Los residentes de Kentucky deben usar kynect para inscribirse en planes del Mercado ACA subsidiados, no la plataforma federal HealthCare.gov. kynect maneja tanto la inscripcion en planes del Mercado como las solicitudes de Medicaid para los residentes de Kentucky en un solo portal. Para 2026, kynect tiene tres portadores: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (108 de 120 condados), y Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (region Bluegrass). Ayuda gratuita de kynectors certificados esta disponible en los 120 condados de Kentucky.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo la ventana del SEP de 60 dias despues de perder mi trabajo en Kentucky?
es.answer: Si pierde el SEP de perdida de cobertura de 60 dias despues de perder su trabajo en Kentucky, sus opciones se reducen significativamente. Medicaid de Kentucky permanece abierto todo el ano si su ingreso califica bajo el 138% FPL. Para los planes del Mercado kynect, tipicamente no puede inscribirse hasta el siguiente Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA, que se lleva a cabo del 1 de noviembre al 15 de enero cada ano (del 1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura 2027). Se aplica una excepcion si ocurre otro evento calificador de vida mientras tanto, como matrimonio, nacimiento de un hijo, o mudanza a un nuevo condado.

es.question: Los ingresos por desempleo cuentan para la elegibilidad del subsidio ACA de kynect en Kentucky?
es.answer: La compensacion por desempleo de Kentucky cuenta como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para calculos de elegibilidad del subsidio del Mercado kynect y de Medicaid de Kentucky. Al solicitar en kynect, estime su ingreso total del hogar proyectado para todo el 2026, incluyendo cualquier beneficio de desempleo que espera recibir. Un estimado honesto que incluya los beneficios de desempleo evita penalizaciones de reconciliacion de subsidios cuando presente su declaracion de impuestos federal de 2026 usando el Formulario 8962 y su 1095-A.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mis hijos despues de perder mi trabajo en Kentucky?
es.answer: El CHIP de Kentucky cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos en familias con ingresos de hasta el 218% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($42,000 para una familia de tres en 2026), con primas bajas o nulas e inscripcion todo el ano. La inscripcion en CHIP de Kentucky se administra a traves de las mismas solicitudes de kynect.ky.gov y benefind.ky.gov que Medicaid. Los ninos pueden calificar incluso si los adultos del hogar no califican para Medicaid. Solicite inmediatamente despues de perder el trabajo, ya que el CHIP de Kentucky no tiene fecha limite de 60 dias, y la cobertura es integral con costos de bolsillo muy bajos.
